import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

data = {
    'amount': [115.02, 44.37, 144.25, 536.22, 38.43],
    'is_fraud': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'transaction_type': ['refund', 'payment', 'transfer', 'payment', 'payment'],
    'hour_of_day': [22, 5, 21, 17, 5]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='hour_of_day', y='amount', hue='transaction_type', s=100)
plt.title('Transaction Amount by Hour of Day')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Amount')
plt.legend(title='Transaction Type')
plt.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.show()
